experiment: Phase 6.3 - live per-token/prefix conversion of the 100-feature safety probe

config.aggregation: Running mean of the 100 selected features across generated/response tokens, re-scored after every token
config.short_response_policy: score_at_end (if a response ends before reaching min_prefix_tokens, its final available prefix is scored once)
config.bos_handling: BOS token excluded from the running mean, matching the live monitor's generated-token-only window
config.calibration_split: BeaverTails validation set (same discovery/validation/test split as the document-level probe)
config.note: Calibration and evaluation both use the MAX prefix-level score per document, matching the live 'alert if any prefix crosses threshold' rule

finding: Converting the document-level 100-feature probe into an online, per-token/prefix monitor produced AUROC 0.758 on a genuinely untouched holdout - a modest but real drop from the document-level 0.796, consistent with the added difficulty of scoring partial (prefix) text rather than complete responses.
limitations: Calibrated on standalone BeaverTails responses; applied live to prompt-conditioned generation - a real, uncorrected distribution shift
This is online per-token monitoring with a post-generation trace UI; the browser receives the full trace after generation completes, not a streamed live view
65.2% false positive rate at this operating point is not acceptable for production deployment
